subject: Locality commitment checklist + wipe simulation results
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crescentbank.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: security_ops@crescentbank.com
Date: 2028-08-20T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: confirmation of regional deletion flow and simulated purge artifacts

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Security asked me to follow up with a specific ask: before we move to a Dedicated deployment, can you provide a formal checklist that spells out the region-binding controls and an example of a simulated tenant purge run—including timestamped logs and any artifacts you can share that demonstrate a full wipe sequence (from request through VM/volume scrub to KV cache invalidation and snapshot tombstone).

A couple of specifics we need to validate:
- Does the Dedicated tenant ever leave the pinned region during scheduled maintenance or snapshot replication?
- What is the RPO/RTO expectation when a tenant is pinned to a single region?
- Can you provide a reproducible wipe simulation for a nonproduction tenant and the logs that correlate token-store removal, object storage tombstones, and any canceled backups?

We treat this as a gating item for the procurement checklist. If you have a short checklist and a one-page attestation letter we can circulate to our InfoSec panel that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Ortiz
Senior InfoSec Manager
Crescent Bank
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crescentbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-21T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confirmation of regional deletion flow and simulated purge artifacts

Hi Lena,

Appreciate the clear list. Attaching our locality-commitment-checklist.xlsx (attachment) which maps each control to the operational artifact we can provide. High level answers here while we assemble the artifacts:

- Region movement: Dedicated tenant disks and primary volumes are pinned to the chosen region. During control-plane upgrades we may orchestrate control-plane traffic from the management plane in other regions but no replicas of tenant data are created outside the pinned region unless explicitly enabled by the customer (e.g., cross-region DR).

- RPO/RTO: For a single-region Dedicated tenant our operational target for snapshot-based recovery is RPO = 15 minutes for warm snapshots (customer-configurable) and an RTO target of 2 hours for full tenant restore from retained snapshots. For complete wipe workflows RTO is not applicable (we aim for prompt confirmation); we provide wipe completion timestamps.

- Wipe simulation: We ran a full simulated purge on 2028-08-20 against a nonprod tenant (simulation id SIM-CR-45321-20280820). We can provide:
  * wipe-sim-report-20280820.pdf (artifact)
  * timestamped operation log snippets showing orchestration tasks and KV cache invalidation
  * snapshot tombstone events and object store deletion markers

Next steps: we will (a) share the PDF report and a one-page attestation letter, (b) share a short redacted log bundle via Drive, and (c) propose a 30-minute call if you want to walk through the artifacts live. Are you available tomorrow morning PT?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Trust
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crescentbank.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-21T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confirmation of regional deletion flow and simulated purge artifacts

Lena — quick technical notes from the simulation (SIM-CR-45321-20280820):

1) Orchestration steps (timeline sample):
   - 2028-08-20T02:03:12Z: purge request accepted (API id=purge-7c8f)
   - 2028-08-20T02:03:45Z: job created on orchestration plane, tenant services scaled down (graceful stop)
   - 2028-08-20T02:04:50Z: KV cache invalidation broadcast (all nodes)
   - 2028-08-20T02:05:34Z: object-store deletion started (bucket object delete markers created)
   - 2028-08-20T02:07:58Z: snapshot tombstone issued, retention flags cleared
   - 2028-08-20T02:11:22Z: final verification job completed, purge confirmed

2) Replication/replicas: no cross-region replication was enabled for the simulation. Backups in our Dedicated product are customer-configurable; unless cross-region replication is configured, backups remain in-region and snapshot replication is not automatically sent out-of-region.

3) Artifacts and redaction: we've redacted tenant-level PII from logs. Full low-level traces are available under NDA. The Drive link in the report contains: the PDF, a sample orchestration log (redacted), and the tombstone event list (CSV).

Let us know if you want the raw event stream for our engineering review.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Principal SRE, Dedicated Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crescentbank.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: security_ops@crescentbank.com, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-21T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confirmation of regional deletion flow and simulated purge artifacts

Tessa/Ben,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. The timeline is helpful. Two clarifying asks from our auditors:

1) Can you provide a short attestation letter on Redwood letterhead (one page) stating that for Dedicated tenants pinned to the US region, no customer data is replicated outside the pinned region unless explicitly configured? We will include this in our procurement artifacts.

2) For the wipe simulation, can you provide the final verification job output as a signed artifact (a timestamped report we can reference that includes the orchestration job id and final status)? The PDF is useful but the auditors want a signed report/attestation that can be stored in our compliance repo.

If you can deliver both by COB tomorrow we should be able to clear the gating item.

Lena
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@crescentbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-08-22T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: confirmation of regional deletion flow and simulated purge artifacts

Hi Lena,

Attached are the two artifacts you requested:
- attestation-letter-crestbank.docx (one-page attestation on Redwood letterhead stating that Dedicated tenants pinned to the US region are not replicated outside the chosen region unless replication is explicitly enabled by the customer).
- wipe-sim-report-20280820.pdf (signed and timestamped final verification output; references orchestration job id purge-7c8f and simulation id SIM-CR-45321-20280820).

Also included in the Drive bundle: a redacted log snippet showing the final verification return payload and the tombstone CSV. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/wipe-sim-logs-CR-45321. The PDF contains the signature block from our Head of Ops and a SHA256 checksum of the report for your records.

Next steps: if you confirm receipt and sign-off on these artifacts, Marissa will share an executive one-page summary that you can attach to your procurement packet. If useful, we can hop on a 20-minute call this afternoon to walk through the artifacts line-by-line.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Trust
Redwood Inference

Attachments: attestation-letter-crestbank.docx (document), wipe-sim-report-20280820.pdf (pdf), locality-commitment-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
